summary: A Claude seat's channel is judged from Claude's own start: it is starting until Claude's SessionStart (stalled after 5 minutes), then has 60 s to an initialized channel, instead of 20 s from the driver's start; the unattached diagnostic names its cause; recovery charges its budget only for a new channel failure, restarting a stalled seat or a repeated cause on a long backoff, with an operational fault after three in a row; the driver resolves claude once for the plugin check and the provider

replay.detail: No graph replay. New values only: the diagnostic status "stalled" and the restart operation claude-channel-recovery-uncharged-v1.

schema.detail: No schema change. The cause is JSON at the end of the existing reason string; "stalled" is a value of the existing open status string, which the store compares only with "starting", so every member, older ones included, folds it to blocked.

rules.detail: Unattached: starting until SessionStart, stalled after 5 min without it, blocked 60 s after it (was 20 s after the driver's settle). Channel recovery: a stalled diagnostic, or a blocked one whose cause signature (kind, route, plugin_check_error, project_st_server) equals the last charged attempt's, restarts without charge on a 5 to 30 min backoff, and raises an operational fault after 3 in a row; other failures keep the 3-in-6-hours budget and park. So a channel that keeps failing for one cause no longer parks the seat: it keeps restarting on the long backoff, and the operational fault after three in a row is what surfaces it.

compatibility.detail: An older member shows a stalled seat as blocked and reads the cause as part of the reason text. An older daemon's recovery treats a stalled diagnostic as blocked and charges it as before. A restart request with the new uncharged operation is an automatic request to this build only; an older build sees it as an explicit restart.

recovery.detail: Revert: the 20 s window and the 3-attempt budget for every unattached seat return.
